name: Patched canvas ridge tent
description: A ridge tent of weathered, patched canvas about 2.5 m long and 1.7 m high on a ridge pole and two uprights, pegged down at the hems; at the front one door flap hangs shut and the other is rolled back and tied open, showing a bedroll with a blanket inside.

provenance.prompt: A ridge tent of patched canvas with one flap tied open and a bedroll visible inside, about 2.5 × 2 × 1.7 m.
